applications_target.name: applications_target
applications_target.value:
("applications"."kind" = 'job' and ("applications"."cluster_id" is not null or "applications"."external_url" is not null))
        or ("applications"."kind" = 'spontaneous' and "applications"."company_id" is not null)

contacts_email_present.name: contacts_email_present
contacts_email_present.value: "contacts"."deleted_at" is not null or "contacts"."email" is not null
